# Stepper

A vertical timeline indicator that renders a list of steps — each with a `status` dot (`complete`, `active`, `error`, or `idle`) — connected by lines.

```ts
import { Stepper, StepStatus } from '@wfm/ui-components';
```

## Step States

Use the `status` prop to control the visual style of the step indicator dot.

| `status`             | Dot style              | Meaning                   |
| -------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------- |
| `undefined`          | Gray filled circle     | Not yet reached (default) |
| `StepStatus.VISITED` | Purple filled circle   | Step completed            |
| `StepStatus.ACTIVE`  | Purple outlined circle | Currently active step     |

```tsx preview
import { Stepper, StepStatus, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex direction="column" padding="6" style={{ maxWidth: 320 }}>
      <Stepper status={StepStatus.VISITED} isEnd={false}>
        <Box paddingLeft="2" paddingBottom="4">
          <Typography variant="caption" weight="medium">
            Step 1 — Completed
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant="caption" tone="subdued">
            Form submitted on Apr 20.
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      </Stepper>
      <Stepper status={StepStatus.ACTIVE} isEnd={false}>
        <Box paddingLeft="2" paddingBottom="4">
          <Typography variant="caption" weight="medium">
            Step 2 — In Progress
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant="caption" tone="subdued">
            Under review by the team.
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      </Stepper>
      <Stepper isEnd>
        <Box paddingLeft="2" paddingBottom="4">
          <Typography variant="caption" weight="medium">
            Step 3 — Pending
          </Typography>
          <Typography variant="caption" tone="subdued">
            Awaiting approval.
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      </Stepper>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## End Step

Use `isEnd={true}` on the last step to hide the vertical connector line below the dot.

- `isEnd={false}` — connector line extends downward to the next step
- `isEnd={true}` — no connector line (must be set on the final item)

```tsx preview
import { Stepper, StepStatus, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex direction="column" padding="6" style={{ maxWidth: 300 }}>
      <Stepper status={StepStatus.VISITED} isEnd={false}>
        <Box paddingLeft="2" paddingBottom="4">
          <Typography variant="caption">
            First step — has connector below
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      </Stepper>
      <Stepper status={StepStatus.VISITED} isEnd>
        <Box paddingLeft="2" paddingBottom="4">
          <Typography variant="caption">
            Last step — no connector (isEnd)
          </Typography>
        </Box>
      </Stepper>
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## All States in a Timeline

A realistic example combining all three states in a sequential workflow.

```tsx preview
import { Stepper, StepStatus, Typography } from '@wfm/ui-components';
import Flex from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-flex';
import Box from '@talkdesk/cobalt-react-box';

const steps = [
  {
    label: 'Created',
    detail: 'Apr 18 — Request submitted',
    status: StepStatus.VISITED,
  },
  {
    label: 'Approved',
    detail: 'Apr 19 — Manager approved',
    status: StepStatus.VISITED,
  },
  {
    label: 'In Progress',
    detail: 'Apr 21 — Being processed',
    status: StepStatus.ACTIVE,
  },
  { label: 'Completed', detail: 'Awaiting completion', status: undefined },
];

export default function Demo() {
  return (
    <Flex direction="column" padding="6" style={{ maxWidth: 340 }}>
      {steps.map((step, i) => (
        <Stepper
          key={step.label}
          status={step.status}
          isEnd={i === steps.length - 1}
        >
          <Box paddingLeft="2" paddingBottom="4">
            <Typography variant="caption" weight="medium">
              {step.label}
            </Typography>
            <Typography variant="caption" tone="subdued">
              {step.detail}
            </Typography>
          </Box>
        </Stepper>
      ))}
    </Flex>
  );
}
```

## Props

| Prop             | Type                                                   | Default               | Description                                                               |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `status`         | `StepStatus.VISITED \| StepStatus.ACTIVE \| undefined` | `undefined`           | Visual state of the step dot                                              |
| `isEnd`          | `boolean`                                              | —                     | **Required.** Hides the connector line when `true` — set on the last step |
| `children`       | `ReactNode`                                            | —                     | Content rendered to the right of the step indicator                       |
| `data-qa`        | `string`                                               | `'stepper-container'` | QA selector attribute                                                     |
| `data-component` | `string`                                               | `'WFMStepper'`        | Component identifier                                                      |

## StepStatus Enum

```ts
enum StepStatus {
  VISITED = 'visited', // Completed step — solid purple dot
  ACTIVE = 'active', // Current step  — outlined purple dot
}
```
